Your quick guide

Make your first sprite

Start at 16 × 16 or 32 × 32. Draw a silhouette, fill it with a base color, then add a shadow and a highlight.

Make mistakes freely

Undo restores a stroke, layer change, or frame edit. Layers keep parts separate. A locked layer cannot be painted.

See the real size

Switch Preview to Native size. Try light and dark backgrounds to check the outline.

Useful shortcuts

B Pencil · E Eraser · F Fill · I Pick color
V Select/move · H Pan · L Line
Ctrl/Cmd Z Undo · Shift Z Redo
Ctrl/Cmd S Download project
+ / − Zoom · Esc Cancel

Canvas keyboard drawing: arrow keys move, Space paints. Middle-button drag pans. Scroll to zoom.

Keep your work

Autosave is on this device, not a cloud backup. Download a project file to keep an editable copy. PNG exports flatten visible layers.

A little practice goes a long way.
